title: 职业健康监护与特殊人群
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/152_职业健康监护与特殊人群.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/152_职业健康监护与特殊人群/src.py

points.K8: 过敏慢病免疫低下要说

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着体检表和听诊器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank health checkup form and a stethoscope, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第13章第六课：职业健康监护与特殊人群。
overlay: 职业健康监护与特殊人群

shots.scene: 欣欣指指心口，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at its chest with a heart icon and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 身体状况，也是安全的一部分。

shots.scene: 小研看着化学品安全数据表上的健康危害象形图，犹豫
shots.prompt_en: In a university laboratory, the female graduate student looks at a safety data sheet showing a health hazard pictogram, hesitating.
shots.narration: 小研刚知道自己怀孕了。

shots.scene: 小研手里的试剂瓶贴着健康危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a reagent bottle in her hand with a health hazard pictogram and a blank label.
shots.narration: 她手头的试剂，可能影响胎儿。

shots.scene: 小研想开口又不好意思
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at the office door of the older man, hesitant, a small thought bubble with a question mark.
shots.narration: 她不好意思开口，想先忍着。

shots.scene: 王老师温和地说话，旁边一把锁的图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator speaks kindly to her, a small padlock icon beside them for privacy.
shots.narration: 王老师：主动说，信息会保密。

shots.scene: 人员与有害因素图标，箭头指向体检
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker near hazard icons for chemicals, dust and noise, an arrow pointing to a medical checkup clinic. No text.
shots.narration: 长期接触有害因素，要做职业健康检查。

shots.scene: 时间轴上三个节点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a timeline with three checkpoints, a door entering, a calendar in the middle and a door leaving, each with a stethoscope icon. No text.
shots.narration: 上岗前、在岗期间、离岗时，都要查。

shots.scene: 上岗前体检，医生看报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a doctor reviews a blank checkup report before a new worker starts a job, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 上岗前查，看身体适不适合。

shots.scene: 日历每年一次体检
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calendar with a repeating checkup mark and a magnifier finding a small problem early. No text.
shots.narration: 在岗定期查，早发现早处理。

shots.scene: 离岗体检，档案夹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker leaving through a door after a final checkup, a folder being closed. No text.
shots.narration: 离岗时查，留下健康底数。

shots.scene: 甲醛瓶、粉尘、噪声、激光图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a formaldehyde bottle, a dust cloud, a noise wave and a laser beam. No text.
shots.narration: 化学品、粉尘、噪声、激光，都可能要查。

shots.scene: 有禁忌的人被引向另一个岗位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with a red medical cross icon guided away from a hazardous workstation to a safer desk. No text.
shots.narration: 身体不适合的，不安排这类工作。

shots.scene: 学校组织去体检机构
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a group of lab staff walk from a university building to a medical examination center. No text.
shots.narration: 学校统一组织，按国家规定执行。

shots.scene: 辐射剂量计和疫苗两个小图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two small panels, a personal radiation dosimeter badge and a vaccine syringe. No text.
shots.narration: 辐射和生物岗位，另有专门要求。

shots.scene: 王老师向新同学讲解危害
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains hazards to the young male student in front of a lab entrance information board.
shots.narration: 实验室有哪些危害，要如实告知。

shots.scene: 门口的职业危害告知卡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hazard notice card on a lab wall with hazard pictograms and protective equipment icons, no readable words. No text.
shots.narration: 危害和防护要求，写在告知卡上。

shots.scene: 老李用采样器做场所检测
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sets up an air sampling pump and a sound level meter in a lab, the displays blank.
shots.narration: 场所检测，由学校统一组织。

shots.scene: 检测结果张贴公示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank results sheet pinned on a notice board, people reading it. No text.
shots.narration: 检测结果，告诉在这里工作的人。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask a question, the safety administrator nodding.
shots.narration: 你有权知道，自己接触了什么。

shots.scene: 阿杰发烧咳嗽、手上贴创可贴，站在门口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with a thermometer icon, coughing, a bandage on his hand, standing at the lab door.
shots.narration: 发烧咳嗽、手上有伤，先告诉负责人。

shots.scene: 老周摆手让他今天先休息
shots.prompt_en: The older man gently stops him at the door and points toward home with a rest icon.
shots.narration: 今天暂不进入，好了再进。

shots.scene: 打哈欠的学生，熬夜图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a yawning student with a moon and a clock showing late night, a stop hand. No text.
shots.narration: 太累、没睡好，也别硬撑。

shots.scene: 实验中头晕，停手举手报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student feeling dizzy at a fume hood stops work and raises a hand to call for help. No text.
shots.narration: 实验中不舒服，马上停下报告。

shots.scene: 就医时把安全数据表交给医生
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student hands a safety data sheet to a doctor in a clinic. No text.
shots.narration: 就医时，说清接触过什么化学品。

shots.scene: 电话拨打 120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone with an ambulance icon on the screen. No text.
shots.narration: 情况严重，立即拨打120。

shots.scene: 长期接触化学品，肺和肝脏图标变灰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person working with chemical bottles over a long calendar, lung and liver icons slowly turning gray. No text.
shots.narration: 长期接触某些化学品，可能得职业病。

shots.scene: 看病时告诉医生工作情况
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a patient tells a doctor about the lab job, a speech bubble with a flask icon. No text.
shots.narration: 怀疑和工作有关，就医时说明。

shots.scene: 报告表从医院和学校发出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: blank report forms sent from a hospital and a university office to a health authority building. No text.
shots.narration: 疑似职业病，学校和医院按规定报告。

shots.scene: 专门的诊断机构
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a medical building with a special stamp icon and a doctor reviewing documents. No text.
shots.narration: 职业病由有资质的机构诊断。

shots.scene: 受影响的人从甲醛岗位移到普通岗位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with a health warning icon moves from a formaldehyde workstation to a low exposure desk. No text.
shots.narration: 接触后身体受影响，先暂时调岗。

shots.scene: 在新岗位观察，医生随访
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the person works at a low exposure desk while a doctor checks in with a calendar. No text.
shots.narration: 调到接触少的岗位，继续观察。

shots.scene: 医生评估后打勾，可以回原岗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a doctor evaluates with a check mark, an arrow back to the original workstation. No text.
shots.narration: 过段时间，再评估能否回原岗。

shots.scene: 原岗位加装排风、改进防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the original workstation fitted with a new local exhaust hood and better gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 同时查原因，改进防护措施。

shots.scene: 档案柜里的健康档案和接触记录
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a locked file cabinet with health record folders and exposure record folders. No text.
shots.narration: 健康和接触记录，要长期保存。

shots.scene: 人员离开、电脑更换，档案仍在
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person leaving and an old computer replaced by a new one, the record folder stays safe. No text.
shots.narration: 人走了、系统换了，记录不能丢。

shots.scene: 本人领取档案复印件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person receives a copy of their own health record folder at a counter. No text.
shots.narration: 本人可以查阅、复印自己的档案。

shots.scene: 档案加锁，旁人打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a health record with a padlock, a curious bystander peeking crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 健康信息保密，不随意外传。

shots.scene: 化学品与胎儿图标，警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chemical bottle and a baby icon with a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 有些化学品，会影响生育和胎儿。

shots.scene: 安全数据表健康危害部分高亮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet with the toxicology section highlighted and a health hazard pictogram. No text.
shots.narration: 安全数据表，会写明生殖毒性。

shots.scene: 小研走进老周办公室说明情况
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student talks with the older man in his office, a calm conversation.
shots.narration: 备孕、怀孕、哺乳，都要主动告知。

shots.scene: 老周和王老师评估后调整安排
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator review a blank assessment form and move a task card to another person.
shots.narration: 负责人评估后，调整工作和防护。

shots.scene: 法规书与母婴图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed regulation book with a mother and baby icon and a shield. No text.
shots.narration: 国家对孕期、哺乳期有专门保护。

shots.scene: 辐射标志与剂量计
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ionizing radiation warning sign and a dosimeter badge with a lower limit arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 辐射岗位，剂量控制更严。

shots.scene: 加锁的信封
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed envelope with a padlock passed only to two people. No text.
shots.narration: 告知内容保密，只让必要的人知道。

shots.section_title: 过敏慢病免疫低下要说
shots.scene: 免疫力低的人与病菌图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with a weak shield icon and germ icons around. No text.
shots.narration: 免疫力低，更容易被感染。
overlay: 过敏慢病免疫低下要说

shots.section_title: 过敏慢病免疫低下要说
shots.scene: 生物危害标志的实验室门口，停下说明
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person stops at a door with a biohazard warning sign and talks to a supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 做病原相关实验，要先说明。

shots.section_title: 过敏慢病免疫低下要说
shots.scene: 过敏的人起红疹、呼吸困难
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with red skin rash and a wheezing icon after contact with a substance. No text.
shots.narration: 过敏体质，接触某些物质会严重过敏。

shots.section_title: 过敏慢病免疫低下要说
shots.scene: 动物毛屑、乳胶手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, animal fur dander and a latex glove, with an allergy warning. No text.
shots.narration: 动物毛屑、乳胶手套，常致过敏。

shots.section_title: 过敏慢病免疫低下要说
shots.scene: 癫痫、心脏病、哮喘等慢病图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a brain with a lightning mark, a heart and an inhaler. No text.
shots.narration: 癫痫等慢性病，也要告诉负责人。

shots.section_title: 过敏慢病免疫低下要说
shots.scene: 老周给学生调整到合适的岗位
shots.prompt_en: The older man assigns a suitable task card to a student with a reassuring smile.
shots.narration: 好让老师安排更合适的岗位。

shots.scene: 年龄日历与高危实验图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a birthday calendar icon next to a high hazard experiment icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 未满十八岁，有些实验不能做。

shots.scene: 准入登记时填写信息
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student fills in a blank lab access registration form at a desk. No text.
shots.narration: 准入登记时，如实说明年龄。

shots.scene: 高危实验门禁，按规定限制
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a high hazard lab door with an access control reader and a stop hand for a young student. No text.
shots.narration: 高危实验，按本校规定限制。

shots.scene: 法规书与盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed law book with a young person icon under a protective shield. No text.
shots.narration: 国家对未成年人有特殊保护。

shots.scene: 三阶段体检时间轴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a timeline with three stethoscope checkpoints. No text.
shots.narration: 接触有害因素，三阶段体检。

shots.scene: 不适报告、调岗、档案
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a raised hand, a moving desk arrow and a locked folder. No text.
shots.narration: 不适就报告，受影响调岗，档案留好。

shots.scene: 孕期、过敏、免疫低下、未成年图标，加锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a pregnant woman, an allergy rash, a weak shield and a young person, with a padlock. No text.
shots.narration: 特殊情况主动说，信息保密。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸懒腰打哈欠，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stretches and yawns, then waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：疲劳、压力与冷热环境。
